title: The treewidth formula for the fall-off value of graph polytopes
statement:
Let $G$ be a graph, let $\operatorname{tw}(G)$ denote its treewidth, and let $\tau(G)$ denote its fall-off value.

**Treewidth fall-off conjecture.** The fall-off value is

$$
\tau(G)=\frac{1}{\operatorname{tw}(G)+1}.
$$

The paper motivates this formula from the graphs analyzed, including trees, cyclic graphs, and graphs of treewidth two, but no resolution is supplied here.
source_name: Ankit Kumar Jha and Ion Nechita, “On random classical marginal problems with applications to quantum information theory”, arXiv:2406.14153 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.14153

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2024).
